First time setup

Every step is optional, and all of it is in Settings later.
  1. What’s your name? People you share boards with see it, in your colour, on whatever you’re editing.
  2. Sync your devices. Saves to your Google Drive so your PC, iPad and phone share one workspace.
  3. Keep a folder copy on this computer. Make a folder called CORKBORK in Documents, then choose it.
  4. No folder needed here. iPad and phone browsers can't use folders, so your work is kept in this browser and in Google Drive.
  5. Install CORKBORK as an app, so it has its own icon and opens even without internet.
  6. Make it yours. Theme, interface size and image storage.
Your work always saves automatically on this device.

Make CORKBORK fit you

These are only defaults. You can change every choice later in Settings.

Settings

Your name and colour
Shown to people you share boards with. It follows you to your other devices.
Color theme
Adjust these colors
Each theme remembers its own edits when you switch. Reset affects only the selected theme.
What changed, newest first. Kept terse on purpose — this file carries its own history, so verbosity costs file size.
Reorder tools, move them into More, add dividers. Saved on this device.
Every tool on the left rail. Click or drag one onto the canvas, or press its key.
NoteNA sticky note for writing. Double-click to type; text can be bold, listed, coloured.
Arrow—Connects two cards. Click one card, then another.
BoardBCreates an entirely new board/working canvas. Double-click to go inside.
ListTA checklist, bulleted or numbered list.
BlockKA titled panel (writing, timeline, list…). Drop cards against its edge to stick them on; they move with it. Select it to see chain links — tap one to unstick. Click it, then Edit to change its type.
ColumnCGroups cards in a vertical stack. Drag cards into it.
FolderGHolds photos and boards in a tidy grid. Drag them in to organize; double-click one to open it.
LinkLSaves a web address with its title and preview.
HeadingHBig text for labelling parts of a board.
ImageIAdds a picture from your device.
UploadUUpload files from your computer's local storage.
Library—Cloud-based library of images, videos and files. Upload your own files to access them from anywhere.
TableE(Under More.) A spreadsheet with formulas.
CardD(Under More.) A character, item or place. Mentions of its name link to it in notes.
D&D sheetR(Under More.) A fillable D&D 5e character sheet.
Everywhere: Ctrl+K search · Ctrl+Z undo · Delete remove · Z fit everything · S snap to grid · F focus mode · ? all shortcuts. Right-click any card for more, such as making a board private.

Cloud sync

Advanced: use your own Google Client ID
How do I get a Client ID?
Google requires the app to be identified before it will hand over access to your Drive. It is free and takes a few minutes, once.
  1. Open console.cloud.google.com and create a project.
  2. Under APIs & Services → Library, enable Google Drive API.
  3. Under OAuth consent screen, choose External, fill in a name and your own email, and add yourself under Test users.
  4. Under Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID, pick Web application.
  5. Add your serving address (for example https://YOUR-NAME.github.io or http://localhost:8080) under Authorised JavaScript origins.
  6. Copy the Client ID it gives you and paste it below.
Your boards and files sync to a CORKBORK folder in your Google Drive, shared by all your devices. Private boards (right-click a board → Make private) stay on their own device. Privacy · Terms

Backups

Back up now keeps a restore point on this device. Save a copy downloads one .corkbork file holding everything. Open a copy loads one back.
Restore an earlier version
Version history. A snapshot of the whole workspace is kept every few minutes, and the newest 10 are retained. Large attachments are shared between snapshots instead of copied into each one. Restoring keeps the current version as a snapshot too, so restoring is itself undoable.

Folder on this computer (optional)

Keeps a readable copy of your originals in a folder you choose, e.g. Documents/CORKBORK.
Not available in this browser. Archive folders work in Chrome or Edge on a computer. iPad and iPhone browsers cannot use folders, so here your files are kept in this browser's storage. Use “Save a copy” below for a backup.
Storage health and repair
Your boards are saved automatically in this browser as a fast working cache. The selected archive folder is the durable master. “Back up now” adds a local restore point. “Save a copy” packages the catalogue and its files together; very large archives are copied directly to another folder instead.

New image imports retain their original bytes in the master archive while CORKBORK keeps a smaller viewing preview.
The saved workspace lives in the browser, not in the HTML file — every corkboard file opened from this computer shares the same boards. That is why a newly downloaded build opens with your existing boards instead of empty. To test a build against a truly blank workspace:
